sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.15
- Google Pay now lands on the Review step so shoppers can check their order before it is charged.
- Guest checkout shows the address the shopper typed on the Review step instead of "Billing address pending".
- Creating an account or checking out with an email that already has an account now offers Sign in and Forgot password, with the email filled in.
- Shoppers who sign in partway through checkout keep the address they typed, and Place Order waits until it is saved.
